name: Bhopali Gosht Rezala
instructions: 1. Heat ghee in a heavy-bottomed pan or pressure cooker and add whole spices (bay leaf, cloves, cardamom, cinnamon, shahi jeera).
2. Add sliced onions and sauté until golden brown.
3. Add ginger-garlic paste and sauté for two minutes until the raw smell disappears.
4. Add mutton pieces and sear them over medium heat until they change color.
5. Mix in the powdered spices (turmeric, chili, coriander) and salt, cooking for a few minutes.
6. Add whisked curd gradually, stirring continuously to prevent curdling.
7. Pressure cook or slow-cook with a little water until the mutton is tender.
8. Stir in the cashew nut paste to thicken the gravy and cook on low heat for 5-7 minutes.
9. Finish with kewra water and garnish with fresh coriander.
description: Bhopali Gosht Rezala is a regal delicacy deeply rooted in the culinary history of Bhopal, reflecting the influence of the Begums of Bhopal. It is a refined version of traditional curries, often served during special occasions, known for its velvety yogurt gravy and subtle floral aroma.
